user.title: Connect GMX mailbox
user.description: Use an app password. POP3/IMAP access must be enabled in the GMX web mailer (E-Mail settings > POP3/IMAP).

data_description.email: The full GMX address; it is also the user name.
data_description.password: Create it under Account > Login & security > App passwords. Required with two-factor authentication.

server.name: Server settings
server.description: Only change these if GMX changes its servers.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate GMX mailbox
reauth_confirm.description: GMX rejected the login for {account}. Either the app password is no longer valid, or GMX switched POP3/IMAP access off after a period of inactivity. Re-enable POP3/IMAP in the web mailer if necessary, then enter the app password.

reconfigure.title: Change server settings
reconfigure.description: Server settings for {account}. The connection is tested with the stored credentials.

error.invalid_email: Please enter a complete email address.
error.invalid_auth_or_imap_disabled: Login rejected. Check the app password and make sure POP3/IMAP access is enabled in the GMX web mailer (GMX switches it off automatically after longer inactivity).
error.smtp_auth_failed: IMAP works, but the SMTP login was rejected.
error.tls_error: The encrypted connection failed (TLS or certificate error).

init.title: GMX mailbox options
init.description: Permissions limit what actions (for example called by an AI assistant) may do. The allowlist is the only hard limit against sending data to third parties.

data_description.permissions: Read is always required. Organize = flags, move, folders, drafts. Delete = move to trash. Send = send, reply, forward.
data_description.allow_permanent_delete: Also needs the Delete level and a confirmation token for each call.

data.allow_reply_to_sender: Allow replies to the original sender

data_description.send_mode: Off: no sending. Allowlist: only listed recipients. Any recipient: requires the entry * in the list.
data_description.allowlist: Exact addresses or *@domain. An empty list blocks sending. Enter * only together with the mode 'Any recipient'.
data_description.allow_reply_to_sender: Replies to the sender of a message even if the sender is not on the allowlist.
data_description.sent_copy_mode: GMX does not store a copy of messages sent via SMTP, so the integration appends one.

limits_section.name: Limits
limits_section.description: Freely adjustable (at least 1). GMX does not publish its sending limits; high values can lead to a temporary account block.

data_description.idle_renew_minutes: GMX closes idle connections after about 30 minutes; at most 25 minutes.

folders_section.name: Special folders
folders_section.description: Leave empty for automatic detection (SPECIAL-USE, then folder name).

data.event_include_headers: Include sender and subject in events

data_description.event_include_headers: Event data ends up in the logbook and recorder and can reach an AI assistant.

error.invalid_allowlist_entry: Invalid allowlist entry. Use exact addresses, *@domain or *.
error.wildcard_requires_any: The entry * is only allowed with the send mode 'Any recipient'.
error.any_requires_wildcard: The send mode 'Any recipient' must be confirmed by adding the entry * to the allowlist.
error.invalid_sent_copy_mode: Unknown mode for the Sent copy.
error.out_of_range: A value is outside the allowed range.

invalid_auth_or_imap_disabled.message: GMX rejected the login. The app password may be invalid or POP3/IMAP access may have been switched off.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot connect to the GMX mail server.

tls_error.message: The encrypted connection to the GMX mail server failed.

imap_possibly_disabled.title: GMX login rejected for {account}
imap_possibly_disabled.description:
GMX rejected the login. GMX switches POP3/IMAP access off automatically after a longer period without use, and then reports the same error as for a wrong password.

1. Log in to the GMX web mailer.
2. Open E-Mail settings > POP3/IMAP and allow POP3 and IMAP access (GMX asks for a security confirmation).
3. If the app password was deleted, create a new one under Account > Login & security > App passwords.
4. Then reauthenticate the integration under Settings > Devices & services.
